page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.3xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor within the Enhanced family. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 48.0 GB of memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU without hardware-level accelerator support.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Local storage is omitted entirely, meaning all filesystem operations require detached network-attached block storage volumes.

Due to its balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory configuration and dedicated core allocation, the instance is structured for general enterprise computing. Workload suitability includes standard web application serving, container orchestration nodes, backend microservices, and continuous integration pipelines.
